payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the Sentence Reordering (SR) task is the most effective among the three pre-training tasks for improving performance in abstractive summarization.

claims.text: Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective pre-training task, achieving the highest ROUGE-2 scores compared to Next Sentence Generation (NSG) and Masked Document Generation (MDG).
Using SR consistently leads to significant performance gains in summarization tasks, outperforming the other pre-training tasks.
The combination of all three tasks (SR, NSG, MDG) does not outperform the best individual task, which is SR.
